title: The Garbled Parley
logline: An automated comms relay mistranslates an isolated militia bunker's offer of truce as a hostile ultimatum, prompting an aggressive naval patrol to prepare an orbital strike unless an independent courier can deliver the raw phonetic audio.

roles.description: An anxious communications technician who discovered the relay translation error; hunted by task force security.
A desperate defensive coordinator in the besieged bunker who transmitted the original dialect offer.
A decorated combat captain convinced the colonists are preparing an ambush; refuses to second-guess automated transcripts.
A forward picket interceptor deployed to jam transmission buoys around the besieged colony.
A heavily armed command corvette maintaining the firing perimeter around the bunker.
An automated patrol drone carrying encrypted fire-control telemetry between the fleet and the relay.
The orbital antenna nexus where automated linguistic algorithms process deep-space signals.
An excavated asteroid redoubt where wounded militia personnel await terms.

public_situation: Naval task forces enforce a tight blockade over {system} as colonial militia forces inside {role:bunker_redoubt_dock} prepare for bombardment.
private_truth: Atmospheric ion interference corrupted the relay's dialect lexicon, turning the militia's conditional surrender terms into a declaration of war.

beats.public_change: The task force broadcasts an ultimatum giving the bunker one solar cycle before bombardment starts.

missions.reason: The clerk needs an independent pilot to shoot down an automated naval drone and recover its translation cache before the fleet burns the raw logs.
missions.private_fact: He knows his own supervisor approved the distorted automated transcript to secure combat hazard pay for the squadron.

beats.public_change: Ion interference deepens around {role:relay_spire_array}, cutting off civilian traffic.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to scan the antenna coils to prove the phonetic distortion was caused by weather rather than intentional militia jamming.
missions.private_fact: He has already booked passage on a private tramp freighter to escape tribunal retribution.

beats.public_change: Militia outposts fire warning flares as the task force advances to bombardment range.

missions.reason: She hires the pilot to disable the forward picket interceptor that is jamming comms channels between the bunker and the flagship.
missions.private_fact: Her bunker is out of filtered oxygen and cannot survive another twelve hours under siege.

beats.public_change: {role:taskforce_commander} moves the flagship into firing orbit over {role:bunker_redoubt_dock}.

missions.reason: The clerk contracts the pilot to attack the command corvette to force the flagship to open an emergency negotiation channel.
missions.private_fact: The commander hails mid-combat offering a hefty naval hush-fund voucher if the pilot turns over the telemetry and allows the strike to proceed.

player_choice.prompt: With the command corvette disabled and the true telemetry in hand, the pilot must choose how to deploy the proof before fleet reinforcements arrive.

options.label: Broadcast the raw phonetic surrender audio across the sector to force an immediate cease-fire
Deliver the raw telemetry to an independent rim news desk while the bunker accepts conditional terms

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot disables the command corvette and broadcasts the raw phonetic surrender audio.
resolutions.summary: The acoustic logs prove the surrender was genuine. {role:taskforce_commander} stands down the fleet, and {role:militia_liaison} negotiates an orderly evacuation.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot broke a naval comms picket to deliver the true surrender audio, averting an orbital massacre.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the commander's hush voucher and hands over the clerk's telemetry chips.
resolutions.summary: {role:taskforce_commander} orders orbital bombardment of {role:bunker_redoubt_dock}. The translation error is erased, and {role:militia_liaison} is buried under rubble.

consequences.public_summary: Word spreads that a pilot took naval money to bury a garbled truce call before the guns fired.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the corrupted telemetry to independent reporters while the bunker surrenders.
resolutions.summary: {role:militia_liaison} surrenders under punitive military occupation. {role:cipher_clerk} reaches safe asylum on his own transport with copies of the corrupted logs.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fails to recover the telemetry or avoids intervening.
resolutions.summary: The naval strike levels {role:bunker_redoubt_dock}. Official fleet dispatches log the action as the suppression of an uncompromising hostile insurgent strongpoint.

loose_threads.detail: The translation dictionary chips show a software compile date matching a naval intelligence update.
Munitions suppliers received standing pre-orders for heavy planetary bombard ordnance forty-eight hours before the truce hail.
The automated transcript validation sheet bears a digital signature created during an off-duty station blackout.

radio_hooks: Naval command issues final ultimatum to entrenched insurgent positions in {system}.
Colonial authorities dispute naval interpretation of broadcast signals, alleging severe relay translation errors.
Commercial traffic advised to clear perimeter zones near {role:relay_spire_array} due to unconfirmed skirmishes.

voice_direction.cipher_clerk: Fast, uneven delivery, rapidly citing timestamp numbers and frequency bands. Pauses nervously between sentences as though expecting an alarm.
voice_direction.militia_liaison: Low, exhausted cadence, speaking through static-heavy transmission equipment with stoic, bitter resignation.
voice_direction.taskforce_commander: Booming, rigid, formal military diction. Cuts off objections immediately and repeats protocol regulations with absolute finality.
